# Phonogram Fun

> Phonogram Fun is a kids' spelling and reading app for iPhone, iPad and Android, made in Australia by Paul Alvares for children aged 5–12. Parents photograph the week's school spelling list and the app turns those exact words into a 5-level "Fill the Gaps" story game, dictation practice and phonogram lessons, teaching spelling by sounds with the 70 Spalding phonograms, Australian voices and Australian spelling. There are no ads.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS and iPadOS ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/phonogramfun/id6775725201)) and Android ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.phonogramfun.app)). Store names: "Kids Spelling: Phonogram Fun" (App Store) and "Phonogram Fun: Kids Spelling" (Google Play); also written "PhonogramFun".
- Ages: designed for children aged 5–12.
- Core feature: photograph the school spelling list; the app imports the words and builds a 5-level "Fill the Gaps" story game, dictation practice and phonogram lessons around them.
- Phonics method: teaches spelling and reading by sounds using the 70 Spalding phonograms, with Australian voices and spelling conventions.
- Other features: interactive 70-phonogram chart with audio; word analyser that splits any word into sound tiles (e.g. sight = s + igh + t); 34 standalone phonogram modules; parent dashboard; daily streaks; Year 1 phonics check practice.
- Pricing (AUD): Free tier with one mission a day, the full phonogram chart and the word analyser. "Phonogram Fun Plus" costs $7.99/month or $59.99/year after a 7-day free trial; subscriptions are managed in the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android).
- Privacy: no ads; minimal data collection; a child's optional first name is stored only on the device. Full details in the [privacy policy](https://phonogramfun.com/privacy-policy.html).
- Non-affiliation: Phonogram Fun is not affiliated with Spalding Education International.

- [The 70 phonograms: every sound, with example words](https://phonogramfun.com/learn/the-70-phonograms.html): all 70 phonograms in teaching order with every sound and an example word, printable
- [Year 1 spelling words (Australia): a week-by-week list](https://phonogramfun.com/learn/year-1-spelling-words-australia.html): five weekly Year 1 spelling lists in phonics order, ten words each, printable, with a ten-minute practice routine
- [Common exception words (Year 1 and Year 2)](https://phonogramfun.com/learn/common-exception-words.html): all 109 Year 1 and Year 2 common exception words (tricky words, sight words) grouped by the one rule each breaks
